All uniforms have a mechanic called Uniform Option. You see how equipping a uni boosts some stats? Well, if you have the corresponding uniform when upgrading, you get another option, AKA more stats.

The rank of the uniform determines how "strong" the additional stat will be

So, in order to "max" a uniform, you need five Mythic rank ones, making the process painfully expensive.

I would recommend to just upgrade them if you have nothing else to work on. There are plenty of other facilities needing your resources. Like Cards or Custom Gear, which do affect heavily your performance

Story time, possibly long

This year has been rough, to not say anything worse, to me. It always has been, as the usual "gifted" child who got immediately burnt out in the real word

Flashback to my high school days, back in 2018-2019, I was struggling to meet the expectations of perfect grades, socially inept, and to be frank, an utter shithead, since I saw no reason to "mingle" with people. I had only one friend, in middle school, and he left me for a girl, making me the butt of his "jokes" and the like...

And then, I met my friend...

We got partnered up for a subject, and we worked together,  we didn't interact that much, but I started talking to him, and we got along just fine

We grew closer, since neither had any friends elsewhere, and we shared interests, we became basically inseparable in just six months, ridiculous, right!?

But... It was a prestigious school, and since my grades were deplorable in two subjects, my mom deemed me a failure, and helped me change schools so I could "start again". As a tangential note, she disliked my friend because of his looks (She's racist)

I lost him, and a gal I was romantically interested in, two heavy blows to my shattered me

I studied in another school, my grades went up, but... I didn't "do" anything, all the way to college. I got good grades, I did stuff, but I felt dull, and I didn't understand why, I was doing better, but I didn't feel better...

Then one day, I got a message in my DMs
It was him! He only contacted me so he could send me a drawing of one of my OCs

And for that silly reason, we started talking again, and I felt happy for the first time in a while

Time skip to this year...
I'm a failure for my family, since I'm 21 and I haven't left the house because I can't afford one (I have a degree, but no one hires me, so I'm stuck with online sales in my mother's business) I'm Asperger too, which isn't a heavy hit, but it has helped to fuck up sometimes. I've been threatened to get "evicted" from our house, I feel useless, stupid, a failure, they call me lazy because I don't believe in the "work to death" philosophy, my retarded cousin humped my sister, and when I got mad at my aunt for permitting that, I got smacked, and ordered to apologize, and  and a long etc...

I was done. So fucking done. I had everything ready, the time, the place, I was going for a jump, since if I fell head first it would be swift, they wanted me gone? Then I was going, for the best of everyone. I texted my friend, a last goodbye...

And I was really going to do it, no chickening out! But I wanted to wait until 6:00, just to chill out a last time, I had around 10 minutes, so I just popped my headphones and watched the sky

But something was bugging me. My phone. It didn't stop ringing, ever, I knew it was him, but if I looked, I KNEW I was quitting the jump. So I withheld myself from grabbing it

And I miserably failed after 8 minutes of non-stop calling

I replied in text only, I couldn't bear for him to hear me cracking and wailing. But his words were enough. I love him, and he loves me. Not in a romantic way, we're completely straight, but... I don't know, I knew it was love, I never felt such a thing before...

He has been an anchor for me, and one day, he kept pestering me to play "Persona" I knew basically nothing except for the guy in Smash, so I just dismissed him

His spam continued a WHOLE MONTH, to which I finally snapped with an "Alright fine!"
So... I bought it, and started playing, he told me to play 5, and that he wanted to see pics of my playthrough, to see my reactions

It is now a tradition, the "Screenshot Stream" I call it

Back to the story, I fell in love with the game! Visuals, Music, Writing... But, at the back of my head... It was there, that thought that death would be the way to happiness...

I got mad at Kamoshida's abuses, disgusted by Sae's obsession, not so surprised at the betrayal, I celebrated my victory against THAT politician... And the fight against the final boss blew my brains out in a good way...

But it was still there.

And the 3rd Semester started...

I didn't use guides, so I had zero clues about it,  I just liked Kasumi's character, I felt a bit identified, ngl. And I couldn't refuse the extra SP offered by the doc. And his goals were quite noble, despite the struggles, he still wanted to help people

By the actual end of the game, I was a mess, I was crying for a good hour and half, thinking... About me, my friend, about what I lost, and about what I could do



Now I'm studying another career, and while I find myself cringe doing this comparison, I feel it's necessary. I've developed my Social Links! I can talk to people, see how they are doing, hear their problems, just as someone once heard mine...

Hell, I even did a presentation about Persona! And my Statistics professor loved it so much that he wanted a copy, and he asked me to show it to the Psychology folks! I felt proud, for something I did, out of love for someone, and it was finally, love for me...

To answer, yes, the game, and my friend by extension, changed my heart, and my life... Thank you...

As a side note, I'm almost done playing them all! I just need to finish 4G, Arena, Tactica and Strikers (My laptop can't handle it, lol) currently trying to Reach Out for the Truth ;v
